purpose: Reusable world-life media scene built from a real 3D billboard/sign donor, scenic dressing, dynamic canvas content, optional ChatterBox/Triplet generation, layered reveal and Almanac memory.

lineage.priorConcept: Dropbox living handoff §39 · Satirical Roadside Media Layer · Billboards / Ad-Busting / Broadcast

sceneRecipe.terrainRule: No black debug base. Terrain edge must end cleanly or use a thin matching-color skirt.
sceneRecipe.contentSurface: measured front/screen plane with CanvasTexture or VideoTexture
sceneRecipe.optionalAudio: distance-based Jingle / broadcast smear / interactive cue

contentModes.content: Billboard-specific signature Triplet or slogan cluster
contentModes.grammar: Billboard persona / POV → SHOW IT → SPIN IT → SELL IT
contentModes.display: sequential lines, typographic panels or short animated transitions
contentModes.seedPolicy: deterministic per billboard/session; no frame-random text spam
contentModes.priority: Card/local context may override generic sponsor pool when explicitly bound.

contentModes.style: HyperNormalisation/Gilliam-like cut-up collage, layered crossfades, ripped edges, occasional parallax
contentModes.firstProof: 2-4 still layers + type + one short crossfade loop; video optional later

contentModes.rule: Use sparingly; most boards stay ambient.

semanticStates.reveal: alternative reading / underlayer / system message / fact layer

chatterbox.actorModel: Billboard may have a sponsor/media persona or campaign identity, not a full NPC body.
chatterbox.signatureDeck: Each hero billboard may bind a small signature triplet/slogan pool.
chatterbox.outputBoundary: Text/content only. ChatterBox never moves billboard geometry, grants rewards or writes world state.
chatterbox.timing: Ambient boards rotate slowly; interactive response only after explicit trigger.
chatterbox.antiSpam: Do not change slogans every few seconds while player is nearby. Prefer 1 stable triplet per encounter/visit, with occasional scheduled variation.

firstSceneProof.goal: Static scenic billboard module with one dynamic content surface
include: one verified Kenney billboard shown in isolation first
small clean procedural terrain patch without black underside

reuseRules: Reuse real 3D billboard donors; do not draw fake generic sign chrome when a donor exists.
Reuse renderCardQuarter()/PDF.js path; no second PDF renderer.
Reuse ChatterBox/Triplet owner for text; no second slogan AI runtime.
Scene host owns placement, terrain, navigation and persistence destination.
Billboard adapter owns measured content plane, texture/video binding and presentation transitions.
Keep most billboards ambient; reserve chat/interactivity for hero objects.
